# image2minecraftskin.com — LLM reference

## Canonical identity

- Name: image2minecraftskin
- Canonical URL: https://image2minecraftskin.com/
- Category: free, browser-based image-to-Minecraft-skin converter
- Primary audience: Minecraft Java and Bedrock players who want to turn an existing image into a skin

## Product answer

image2minecraftskin converts a portrait, character illustration, pixel-art image, pet photo, or logo into a downloadable Minecraft skin texture. The conversion runs locally in the browser: image pixels are not uploaded, stored, or used to train a model. No account is required.

## Supported inputs and outputs

| Input | Output | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP | Java Edition 64×64 PNG | Classic (4 px arms) or Slim (3 px arms) |
| PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP | Bedrock Edition 128×128 PNG | Classic or Slim model |

Images up to 10 MB are accepted. Front-facing, centered subjects with a square crop and a transparent or plain background produce the most reliable results. Full-body or busy scenes may need the built-in zoom and position adjustments.

## How to use

1. Open the generator at https://image2minecraftskin.com/.
2. Upload a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP image.
3. Choose Java 64×64 or Bedrock 128×128 and Classic or Slim.
4. Adjust framing if needed, generate the skin, and download the PNG.
5. Import the downloaded PNG in the Minecraft profile or character-creator skin menu.

## Related tool

The [Minecraft Skin Viewer](https://image2minecraftskin.com/minecraft-skin-viewer) validates existing 64×64 and 128×128 skin PNGs and previews them as a 3D character. It is useful for checking a generated file before importing it into Minecraft.

## Privacy and limitations

- Processing is client-side and image content never leaves the device.
- This is a converter, not a pixel editor, username lookup service, or generative image model.
- Downloaded PNGs can be edited in Blockbench or another image editor.
